audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Penny’s complete countryside field trip, every farming, animal, mineral and parenting response branch, and the refusal ending. All spoken lines, questions, player choices, child dialogue, lesson definitions, star-point references, gender branches, regional-resource claims, jokes, boundaries, and parenting discussion were reviewed in full event context with canonical Grampleton terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, forks and response IDs, runtime gender selectors, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Forest records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
